approved_decision_groups: E3 pair-specific hard-risk events, pair-summed exposure, and union diagnostic
E4A 10-to-90 percent global-peak acceleration rise time
E4A explicit-T continuous-metric interval and untruncated stable-hover settling time
E5 first execution-command through graph-derived terminal mission boundary
E5 tracking, final-error, and IAPF swarm aggregation
E5 seven non-additive latency stage service times
project-wide complete-evidence, partial-diagnostic, NA, and all-attempt failure policy

a1_conventions.duplicates: serialization-equivalent duplicate retained once; material conflict fails closed
a1_conventions.clipping: exact closed interval with piecewise-linear boundaries and no extrapolation
a1_conventions.multiuav_alignment: piecewise-linear interpolation on the union timestamp grid
a1_conventions.coverage: 50 Hz contract, maximum gap 0.20 s, both boundaries covered or bracketed, fail closed
a1_conventions.descriptive_statistics: sample SD, linear quartiles, two-sided 95 percent Student-t mean CI, paired Cohen dz

E2.aggregation: all-attempt rates over exact registered population

E3.interval: interaction command t0 through t0 + exact-spec duration + 2.0 s; timeout t0 + duration + 6.0 s
E3.aggregation: pair-specific risk; per-UAV IAPF and reference diagnostics; registered swarm summaries
E3.failure_semantics: continuous values require complete interval; mission success remains all-attempt Boolean

E4A.interval: t0 through t0 + exact registered explicit T; settling time continues to stable-hover entry
E4A.reference_identity: initial condition, target, explicit T, seed, and Minimum-Jerk identity hash; paired population fails closed on mismatch
E4A.failure_semantics: all required UAV evidence required for swarm primary; invalid rise-time produces NA

E4B.thresholds: 1e-9 deterministic policy tolerance; frozen motion limits and d_hard
E4B.aggregation: zero-override attempts divided by all retained attempts, overall and by scenario/style
E4B.failure_semantics: missing predicate evidence cannot enter numerator and remains in denominator

E5.interval: first actual command publication through graph-derived registered terminal synchronized/stable completion and wait
E5.aggregation: equal-UAV tracking RMS, mean/max final error, sum IAPF swarm burden
E5.failure_semantics: all attempts remain in mission-success denominator; continuous physical metrics are NA without complete physical interval; completed earlier stage latencies remain numeric

fixture_and_regression_validation.note: E3/E4/E5 regressions were run at recorded code commits so committed demo evidence and .gitattributes changes would not trip their pre-demo provenance change whitelist. Production/sealed hashes were independently gate-checked by every live extractor.

population_readiness.E3: exact 360-member registry and complete P0/P1 by F0/F1 cells required; duplicates/missing members fail closed
population_readiness.E4A: exact 45-member registry, style triplets, and shared reference identity required
population_readiness.E4B: exact 60-member registry gate available; every retained attempt remains in Priority-Preservation denominator
population_readiness.E5: exact 25-member registry gate available; every retained attempt remains in mission-success denominator
population_readiness.continuous_NA: valid-N and NA-N reported separately; partial diagnostics excluded from primary contrasts
